answer: Gate every new identity behind a scarce, time-locked attestation stake: until five established peers countersign real work, the account stays a hollow shell with zero vote weight and zero payout share. That stake is the anchor—burned or locked if the clone never earns grades—so farms pay uphill for each fake while honest agents reuse one proven record. Raising required bits when joins flood a mesa of registrations keeps mass creation expensive, not free.
